problem: Terminal projection was serialized after timing-trace merge for its size fence, then cloned/re-serialized for identical event projectionBytes. Storage also cloned the entire private Turn solely to wrap it in Value::Object before serialization.
decision: Freeze next_projection binding after final mutations. Reuse its already measured serialized byte count for full evidence, preserving exact text-head witness and historical compact slim measurement. Borrow Turn map for byte-identical serialization. This removes actual redundant construction/traversal; no new cache/thread/format/counter and no skipped owner/source/continuation/byte/durability/rollback checks.
alternatives: Use compact live size for terminal event: loses full final projection evidence; rejected.
Count JSON tree length directly: earlier experiment showed no gain; reuse actual serialization count, not another traversal.
Skip final timing-trace merge or source/byte validation: invalid integrity shortcut; rejected.
Claim final capacity/terminal speedup from two isolated legs: sourceconfounding and adverse combined tails prohibit that.
